coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: The output matches 2 of 9 ground-truth variable categories: target properties (p-logP, QED, and a binding-affinity proxy) and structural diversity, including ultra-long carbon-chain features. These matches yield 22%.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output omits the fixed pipeline scripts and DeepSpeed configuration, ESR1/ACAA1 targets, synthetic versus natural-product domains, top-three property scores, and specified binding-affinity improvements. Its alternative experimental arms do not clearly reproduce the pretrained, chemical-feedback-finetuned, and baseline configurations. It substitutes a composite-metric and proxy-based experiment for the specified design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion states the high p-logP performance, maintained or improved QED, lower KD values with approximately 96.7% and 70.4% improvements for ESR1 and ACAA1, mitigation of molecular hallucinations, or maintained diversity.
